ideas.title: Investigating the Impact of Trump Administration's Funding Cuts on Vulnerable Populations
ideas.description: This story would investigate the impact of the Trump administration's funding cuts on low-income families and individuals, including those who rely on childcare and Medicaid.
ideas.angle: The human impact of funding cuts
questions: What are the specific programs being cut?
How will these cuts affect vulnerable populations?
ideas.insight: I believe this story is important because it highlights the human impact of funding cuts, which can often be overlooked in policy discussions. By investigating the specific programs being cut and the people affected, we can shed light on the real-world consequences of these decisions.
